notes: Indigo runs on Shopify (permanent domain d87ce2-43.myshopify.com). Product grids are rendered client-side by Constructor.io (ac.cnstrc.com), which is unreachable from this network (TCP connect timeout on every cnstrc.com host, and WebFetch could not reach it either), so the on-page 'N products' header text could not be read directly. Counts were therefore established by FULL ENUMERATION of each collection through two independent public Shopify endpoints that agree exactly on every row: (a) /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 paged to exhaustion, and (b) Shopify Storefront API collection(handle).products connection paged via cursor. Water Bottles was additionally confirmed by /collections/water-bottles.oembed (21 products, uncapped; the oembed feed caps at 50 for the larger collections). Cross-checks: the five child collections sum to 395 vs 414 for the parent 'Home & Entertaining' collection, and Mugs(136)+Candles(52)=188 exactly equals the combined 'Candles & Mugs Shop' collection (188). CAVEAT: /collections.json reports a larger products_count for these same handles (Home Decor 201, Candles 192, Mugs 282, Entertain & Serve 251, Water Bottles 44, Home & Entertaining 1082). Those figures include products no longer published to the storefront - they are not internally consistent (282+192=474 != 443 for the combined shop) and none of those products are reachable or browsable, so the enumerated live counts above were used. If the orchestrator can render the Constructor grid in a real browser, the on-page header count is worth a spot-check against these numbers. Category tree taken from the site's own mega-menu (data-menu-json attribute, 'lifestyle' menu, 'Home' group): Water Bottles, Candles, Mugs, Home Decor, Entertaining, Shop All. 'Shop All' (/collections/home-entertaining, 414) excluded as a navigation page. Also inspected and rejected: /collections/lighting (32) and /collections/sculpture - books ABOUT lighting/sculpture, not products; /collections/collectibles-figurines - toys/blind boxes; /collections/thermos - brand page; /collections/candles-and-mugs - marketing shop landing overlapping Mugs+Candles; /collections/seasonal-decor - seasonal landing mixing ornaments, guest books and tea towels; kids-room-decor and baby-nursery-decor - kids/baby, out of scope. Books, stationery, toys, apparel, bags and sleepwear were all out of scope.
